title: IMP — Digital library and corpus of historical Slovene
notes: IMP is the IMPACT-project digital library/corpus of historical Slovene (658 texts, 1584-1919), published as hand-corrected TEI P5 transcriptions with facsimile links and lemma/MTE morphology. CLARIN.SI handle 11356/1031 (verified live) is exactly the RQ source: it contains filenames such as 'ZRC_00001-1584-ana.xml' (Jurij Dalmatin's 1584 Bible) and 'ZRC_00002-1695-ana.xml' (Janez Svetokrski), matching the origin verbatim. License CC BY-SA 4.0 (CLARIN.SI); the site nl.ijs.si/imp is still online though the project completed in 2014. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Tomaž Erjavec, Jožef Stefan Institute (IJS), Ljubljana; funded by EU FP7 IMPACT
